description: Squid Proxy Audit — Offline security audit of a Squid squid.conf. Evaluates http_access first-match order to detect an OPEN PROXY (allow rules that do not restrict source, e.g. allow all or allow CONNECT), very wide src acls, Squid's implicit default (a final conditional deny means everything else is ALLOWED), missing or late deny !Safe_ports / deny CONNECT !SSL_ports, port acls widened to 1-65535, undefined acls, cache manager exposed beyond localhost, SSL-bump sslproxy_cert_error allow all and DONT_VERIFY_PEER, follow_x_forwarded_for allow all (IP spoofing), SNMP/ICP/HTCP open, basic auth over cleartext, root user, forwarded_for/Via/version leaks and access_log none. Credentials are never echoed. Returns PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, openProxy, score, grade, findings with fixes, parsed rules/acls and a hardened example. Pass the file in text=. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
acl localnet src 10.0.0.0/8
acl SSL_ports port 443
http_access allow all
http_port 3128
